correctness.rationale: The rate-one embedding makes the per-type refresh clocks independent, with rates w_i, and sends the step PGF at z=1/(1+s) to the hitting-time Laplace transform. The strong-Markov resolvent identity divides the empty-to-full resolvent by the full-to-full one, giving the stated positive-integral ratio and its subset expansion, also at p=0. A uniformly positive chance of drawing and successfully refreshing every coupon within the next m steps ensures finite mean; the coefficient of s in the ratio gives the stated mean. Under any nontrivial balancing, x+y with x=exp(-at), y=exp(-bt) strictly decreases for t>0 while xy is fixed. Thus the numerator rises strictly and the denominator never rises, so T-transforms prove strict PGF order, without giving ordinary stochastic order. Subtraction in the mean integral gives the pairwise gap; for m=2 its integral is (1+r)(1/a+1/b-4)=(a-b)^2/((1-p)ab). Along the direction e_i-e_j at uniform weights, that same integrand expands as epsilon^2 t^2 exp(-t/m) times the stated bracket; permutation symmetry gives the tangent Hessian coefficient for every tangent direction. The uniform value follows by substituting x=exp(-t/m) in the mean integral and telescoping in the exponent: the increase in the integral divided by m from exponent k-1 to k is (1+r)^k/k. originality.rationale: An earlier Resultary record in the identical local-refresh model gives the exact weighted PGF, exact subset and product-integral mean, and strict mean majorization. Its proof gives exactly the separate pointwise strict Schur concavity of the PGF numerator product and Schur convexity of the denominator product. Multiplying by exp(-st), integrating and dividing positive quantities mechanically gives the headline strict PGF majorization, even though that earlier record does not spell it out. The pairwise penalty and local curvature are respectively a direct two-factor subtraction and second differentiation of its already-known mean integral. The record is not rejected for an inaccessible article or for relying on a classical method, but for demonstrable coverage of the purported contribution.
residual_risks: A broader product-chain theorem or the inaccessible fragile-coupon text may add other comparisons; neither is needed for the specific demonstrated coverage.
